method: LICENSES/BouncyCastle.txt is a manual, human transcription of the licence paragraphs rendered by https://www.bouncycastle.org/licence.html -- it is NOT byte-fetched/verbatim HTML, and its SHA-256 cannot be reproduced by re-fetching that URL. To let a reviewer independently check the transcription, this repository separately commits the raw HTML snapshot fetched from that URL on 2026-08-24 at docs/evidence/license-sources/bouncycastle-licence-2026-08-24.html, hashed below as source_html_sha256. transcription_sha256 is the SHA-256 of LICENSES/BouncyCastle.txt itself. Whether the transcription is a faithful, complete rendering of the source HTML is an OPEN counsel determination, not asserted by this script.
